title: feat(types): split StaticTableColumn off the rich TableColumn so declared = enforced holds per renderer (#5474, Option C)
body:
Fixes #5474

## What this does — maintainer ruling 2026-08-22, Option C (「接受所有」), executed verbatim

**Split the types so `declared = enforced` holds per renderer.** `TableColumn` remains the rich shared shape `data-table` honours — byte-untouched, and pinned untouched. The static `table` renderer gets its own narrow declared subset, `StaticTableColumn`, transcribing its measured read set: `header`, `accessorKey`, `className`, `cellClassName`, `width`.

The eleven keys the static renderer never read leave its surface down the ADR-0049 retirement path as **tombstones** (`?: never` on the interfaces, `z.never().optional()` on the zod twins — the `crud.ts` `confirm` convention): `hoverable` / `striped` on `TableSchema`, and `minWidth` / `align` / `fixed` / `type` / `sortable` / `filterable` / `resizable` / `editable` / `cell` on its columns. Authored values are now **refused loudly** (tsc error + parse rejection naming the key) instead of silently ignored — the ruled outcome, deliberately not softened: a plain key deletion would have been *worse* than the status quo, since the zod objects are non-strict and an undeclared key is silently stripped/passed through.

## Census re-derivation (PM mechanism assumption 1)

The card's `grep -oE '(schema|col)\.[a-zA-Z]+'` census was re-derived with a stronger instrument: full-file read of `table.tsx` (no destructured reads, no computed access besides `row[col.accessorKey]` which reads DATA, and the only helper call receives `schema.footer`, already counted) plus the `SchemaRenderer` prop-flow (its `componentProps` spread leaks unread schema keys onto the DOM element as attributes — cosmetic, not behaviour). **The census is exact: 9 read / 11 inert.** The instrument now lives in the tree: `table-declared-equals-enforced.test.tsx` re-derives the read set on every run and FAILS if a destructure/computed-access/whole-object-helper pattern ever blinds it.

## Shared-consumer enumeration (ruling precondition)

Every `TableColumn` consumer, enumerated before the split: `DataTableSchema.columns` + `onColumnsReorder`, `CRUDSchema.columns` (crud.ts), detail-view relations (`views.ts` related sections), `CRUDBuilder.column()/columns()` (core schema-builder), and the zod `TableColumnSchema` (used by zod `DataTableSchema`). **All stay on the rich shape**; the only consumer that moves is `TableSchema.columns` — the static renderer itself. Split cost: one new interface + one new zod object. The recorded Option-B fallback was not needed.

## The documented-as-working pair (PM mechanism assumption 2)

`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` §TableSchema taught `hoverable`/`striped` as working (property table + copyable example + section intro "optional striping, and hover effects"). All three corrected; the columns row now names the enforced static subset and points the interactive keys at `data-table`. The retirement sweep also cleans the two other corpus sites that authored inert keys on static tables: `packages/types/examples/data-display-examples.json` (`hoverable`/`striped`/`sortable`/`type`) and `apps/site/app/playground/page.tsx` (`hoverable`/`striped`). Palette metadata: the registration's `columns` input description gains the missing `cellClassName` (was already narrow otherwise; the designer palettes author no column keys).

## Acceptance property, pinned as an instrument

- `packages/components/.../table-declared-equals-enforced.test.tsx` — derives the renderer's read set from source and compares it BOTH WAYS against the zod live (non-tombstoned) keys: declared-but-unread and read-but-undeclared each fail with the direction named. Blind-spot-guarded (see above). Plus runtime-inert receipts: smuggled retired keys leave the renderer's HTML byte-identical (so the split cannot be mistaken for a behaviour change, and Option A cannot land by accident).
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/static-table-narrow-surface.test.ts` — the loud-refusal pins (every retired key, error path named, at top level and inside `columns`), the rich-surface-untouched controls (zod accepts + tsc accepts + zero tombstones on `TableColumnSchema`), and key-set lockstep (`keyof StaticTableColumn` ≡ `keyof TableColumn`; 5 live + 9 tombstones).

## Verification (all at `c3cb8c3c4`, this branch's single commit)

- Targeted new suites: 29 tests green; union `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/components/src/renderers/ scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts` → **126 files / 1318 tests green** at `c3cb8c3c4`.
- Typecheck: types (`tsc --noEmit` + examples + tests projects) and components (`tsc --noEmit` + tests) — 5 projects green against the rebuilt closure; the components leg imports `StaticTableColumn` through `dist/index.d.ts`, a symbol only the rebuilt output carries, so the green cannot come from a stale build.
- Reverse verification (both legs mutation-proven on disk by anchored grep, restore-proven, run against source — the vitest root config aliases both packages to `src`, so no dist is in the loop for these suites): softening the `hoverable` tombstone → 2 predicted refusal pins red; deleting the renderer's `cellClassName` read → the instrument's "declared live but never read" leg red.
- Gates: `check-changeset-presence` ✓ (one changeset, `minor`, no `major` per version policy), `check:control-bytes` ✓, `check:doc-types` ✓, `check:spec-symbols` ✓, package lint (types + components) ✓.
- **Declared narrowing:** `check:doc-snippets` self-reported NOT RUN locally (it needs the full workspace built — 15 packages); it and the full farm belong to CI on this PR. `apps/site` build likewise CI's (the edit there deletes two object keys from an example literal).

## Overlap notes for in-flight work

`packages/types` is single-occupancy this round (this card). No files overlap #5777 / #5756 / #5720 / #5567. Out-of-scope finding filed: #5821 (rich `TableColumnSchema` zod mirror omits `editable`, a key `data-table` reads — measured, unassigned). The stale skills teaching of `label` on a static table was found already filed as #5473; nothing new to add there. #5473 and #5821 remain open and are not addressed here.
